subject: Commercial intake: procurement route & trial success gates
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Commercial intake: procurement route & trial success gates

Hi Amelia / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap plus a few asks so we can lock in a smooth trial and clear billing trigger: 

Recap (from our discovery)
- Primary use case: customer-facing summarization of support tickets (short-form, low-latency)
- Target load: ~10k renders/day during pilot, ramp to ~50k/day in month 2 if successful
- Success criteria: >85% reduction in agent handle time for sampled tickets + latency under 400ms  p95

Procurement / commercial path options we discussed
- Card: fast, self-serve; earliest start for trial billing control is immediate
- PO: requires vendor form + internal PO creation; typical 2–3 week lead time for Avery
- Marketplace (AWS Gov/Marketplace): you said this is interesting long-term but procurement prefers direct PO for contracts

What I need from you to confirm next steps
1) Which billing path do you prefer for the pilot (card / PO / marketplace)?
2) If PO: please share the vendor form and your procurement contact (we can pre-fill vendor details)
3) Trial start date preference (we can provision starting the day you confirm; typical pilot length = 30 days)

Attachments: Redwood-Commercial-Checklist-v1.pdf (short checklist), Procurement-Questionnaire_Avery.pdf (sample answers we fill).

Proposed next steps (if you want):
- If card: we start provisioning on your go-ahead and share credentialing steps (5–10 min)
- If PO: I’ll loop Laura (CC) to prioritize the contract side and Monica to confirm pricing bands

Happy to hop on a 15-min call with procurement if that expedites things.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Thanks Rishi — useful recap. A few clarifications from procurement side: 

1) Procurement preference: PO for anything beyond $50k total annualized spend; for a 30-day pilot under $5k we can do card, but our vendor onboarding team prefers to start the PO paperwork early so it’s ready if we expand.
2) Vendor form: attaching our vendor request form (procurement@averytech.com).
3) Start date: we prefer to target Sep 1 start for the pilot (gives internal stakeholders time to prep sample data).

I’m looping Tom (IT/security) and procurement inbox so they have context. We’re open to marketplace later but want Redwood on a PO path for predictable terms.

--
Amelia Singh
Head of Customer Success | Avery Technologies
amelia.singh@averytech.com

Hi procurement team —

Thanks for the vendor form. I’ve attached a pre-filled version with Redwood’s standard vendor details and our short commercial checklist. Laura is copied to help fast-track any SOW/PO language.

Notes for procurement (quick):
- Pilot pricing model: metered per 1k tokens; estimated pilot spend ~ $3.2k for 30 days at expected usage (we can set a hard cap)
- Billing trigger: start of pilot + 30 days unless you request to convert earlier to paid subscription
- SLA & data: Redwood offers audit logs and optional SOC2 evidence; we can provide a redacted SOC2 snapshot or sign an NDA if needed

Attached: MAP_Trial-SLA-proposal.xlsx (breakdown + suggested PO wording).

Laura: could you advise on the minimal contract language procurement will need to accept a pilot PO (we typically append a simple order form + PO reference)?

Thanks,
Rishi

Hi all —

Quick guidance from legal/contracting: for a pilot PO we need:
- Purchase order referencing Redwood Inference (EIN: 81-1234567) and the order form attachment
- Term: 30 days (pilot) with option to convert to annual subscription; cancellation at end of pilot if not converted
- Liability cap: standard pilot language (limits to fees paid during pilot)
- Data / security: reference to our Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and SOC2 evidence link (we can provide a specific file if you need it)

If procurement can send a PO referencing the attached order form and note "Pilot - not renewable without mutual consent", we can accept a PO within 24–48 hours of receipt and provision immediately on Sep 1.

Laura Bennett
